messages:
Ana L.: Quick sync — NovaSoft product team requested a sandbox connector that wires LangChain + LlamaIndex to our Gateway. They want a co-demo week of Nov 7. Who can scope integration work?
Mike R.: I can lead bizdev side. Need technical checklist + public/private repo access for their SI.
Jess (PM): Timeline: Nov 7 demo => engineering needs green by Oct 23 for rehearsals. Are there blockers on legal/co-marketing?
Oliver - Integrations: Tech ask: connector must support streaming, function calling, and be compatible with our auth headers. Prefer a small sample using our `redwood-gateway` adapter.
Piotr (Eng): Ok. Rough ETA: 2 sprints to make an official connector + CI. Could do a "lab" build (non-prod) in 1 sprint if we limit to text generation and embeddings.
Ana L.: Good. Can we do a canary flow for their SI to trial in our sandbox? Need steps and owner.
integration-bot: sandbox cluster deploy started: job 5023. Logs: https://infra.logs/5023
Oliver - Integrations: I'll own the sandbox runbook. Plan: 1) repo scaffold 2) sample prompts + eval set 3) smoke test harness 4) canary guide for SI.
Mike R.: Also marketing needs copy for joint announcement. Draft assets due Oct 25.
Jess (PM): Piotr — can you post a minimal smoke-test script? Example: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"input":"Summarize this..."}' \
  https://sandbox.redwood.ai/v1/gateway/novasoft
```

Piotr (Eng): Pushed a stub to `partners/novasoft-connector` branch. CI will run nightly. I'll add test vectors tomorrow.
Ana L.: Awesome. Next steps: Oliver to share runbook by Oct 10. Piotr to confirm streaming support by Oct 12. Mike & Jess to align on co-demo script by Oct 18.
Mike R.: I'll loop NovaSoft and ask for integration lead. Tagging @Oliver.
Oliver - Integrations: noted. Will share runbook draft EOD Thu.
integration-bot: reminder set for 2024-10-10 09:00 UTC — Partnership sandbox runbook draft due
Ana L.: Thanks team :thumbsup:
